items.title: Choose indexed folders
items.description: Select local folders to search. Pause roots, exclude generated folders, and control hidden files.

items.title: Control search and app content
items.description: Choose search scopes, filename priority, semantic search, and the public Lumen help index.

items.title: Set up on-device AI
items.description: Choose a local engine, check Windows AI and NPU availability, and prepare supported local language models.

items.title: Windows agents and provider routes
items.description: Discover Windows agent launchers, register Lumen's browser agent, and manage AgentGateway provider routes.

items.title: Control browser tasks
items.description: Configure browser-only Computer Use in Microsoft Edge. Review cloud consent and one-time safety approvals.

items.title: Manage AI privacy and permissions
items.description: Control local text tools, OCR, image descriptions, language tools, model downloads, and local microphone dictation.

items.title: Pause work while gaming or on battery
items.description: Control indexing activity during games, fullscreen video, and battery use.

items.title: Change appearance and motion
items.description: Choose theme, transparency, density, previews, reduced effects, and reduced motion.

items.title: Check integration availability
items.description: Refresh diagnostics for local search, Windows AI, Edge APIs, package identity, models, and native services.

items.title: Configure the launcher shortcut
items.description: Set the keyboard shortcut, startup behavior, and launcher monitor placement.
